Learn About Lymphedema & How Common It Is

Lymphedema is a chronic swelling condition that affects millions of people, yet it’s often overlooked or mistaken for everyday swelling. Caused by a buildup of lymph fluid in the body, it can lead to heaviness, tightness, discomfort, and reduced mobility. While many associate lymphedema with cancer treatment, it can also develop after surgery, injury, or for reasons unrelated to cancer. Because the signs aren’t always obvious, many people may be living with symptoms without realizing it.
Learn what lymphedema looks and feels like.

Small. Light. Compact. Connected. Now that’s Nimbl™.
Nimbl delivers innovative and effective pneumatic compression therapy, with a small, light, and compact controller designed for an improved patient experience.
At home or on the road, patients can take Nimbl wherever they go.

Chronic respiratory conditions and neuromuscular disorders can make it harder for the lungs to clear mucus. Changes in the airways—such as swelling or inflammation—can cause mucus to stick, and for people with neuromuscular disorders, weak cough muscles may prevent mucus from being cleared at all. When mucus can’t move, it can build up over time, leading to chronic cough, infection, and flare‑ups. AffloVest is a comfortable, effective, and connected airway clearance therapy that helps gently loosen and move mucus so it can be cleared more easily—helping people breathe easier and stay engaged in daily life, at home or on the go.
Review our guide on chronic venous insufficiency (CVI) to better understand the symptoms, causes, and treatment options to get the care you need.

Edema Guide: What Is Edema?

If you’ve ever experienced swelling in your body, whether it be your ankle, leg, or arm, you may have edema. Edema is the medical term for swelling, and it can be caused by a number of factors, such as a disease, medication, or allergy.

pages.raw_title: About Tactile Medical - Leader in Lymphedema Treatment and Products
pages.raw_meta: Learn why our mission is to help people suffering from chronic diseases live better and care for themselves at home.
raw_blocks: Lifting Care Isn’t Something One Company Can Do Alone — But It Is Something We Can Lead
We reveal and treat people with underserved chronic conditions and help them care for themselves at home
We are – Lifting Care. Everywhere.
In every interaction, whether in person or through the many ways we touch lives, we commit to trust, compassion, and excellence. It is how we will show up every day, everywhere.
We are lifting awareness – So no patient is misdiagnosed, and no provider is left in the dark.
We are lifting access – By breaking down cost barriers and complexity with innovations that simplify the system for everyone.
We are lifting product innovation – Expanding the reach and relevance of therapy through smart, proven, patient-first devices that are more connected, more portable, and more intuitive.
We are lifting the patient experience – Clearing the path, reducing the noise, and providing proactive support from diagnosis to daily life.
At Tactile Medical, we specialize in developing at-home therapy devices to treat lymphedema and chronic venous insufficiency.
Our approach to supporting patients living with chronic swelling combines:
Innovative devices: Advanced pneumatic compression devices backed by clinical research offer targeted relief from swelling and related symptoms.
Personalized care: A nationwide team of Territory Account Managers and Patient Education Consultants who ensure patients receive personalized setup, training, and follow-up.
Comprehensive support: Reimbursement experts, patient advocates, and clinical staff streamline access and offer guidance on navigating insurance claims, condition-specific education, and more.

Our combination of products and services ensures that tens of thousands of patients annually receive the at-home treatment necessary to better manage their chronic conditions. Not only are patients able to improve their quality of life, but our solutions help increase clinical efficacy and reduce overall healthcare costs. Discover our lymphedema solutions to learn how pneumatic compression devices like the Nimbl™ or Flexitouch ® Plus system can help you.
Located just outside of downtown Minneapolis, MN, our corporate HQ includes our clinical, compliance, payer relations, plus commercial operations, finance, HR, IT, marketing, and more.
Engineering, Quality, R&D and Supply Chain teams call our New Brighton facility home, where our U.S. domestic products are manufactured – and our legacy of patient-first innovation is proudly built.
